description:
pkix-ct/src/verify.rs is 1359 lines in one file. Contains 6 distinct concerns:
1. SCT signature verification (x509_entry + precert_entry) — verify_sct_for_cert, verify_sct_for_precert, build_signed_input_* helpers
2. SCT batch verification — verify_embedded_scts
3. Merkle inclusion proof — verify_inclusion, verify_inclusion_inner, inner_hash, merkle_leaf_hash
4. MerkleTreeLeaf builders — merkle_tree_leaf_for_cert, merkle_tree_leaf_for_precert, build_merkle_tree_leaf_*
5. STH verification — verify_sth, build_signed_input_tree_head, SignedTreeHead struct
6. Helpers — tbs_without_sct_list, issuer_key_hash_from_cert, tls_alg_to_x509_oid, log_window_contains

Module is navigable today (well-organized + sectioned) but at this size, future contributors will struggle to add the next feature (RFC 9162 v2, SCT-list signature, etc.) without scrolling. Pre-1.0 is the moment to split.

Suggested split:
- pkix-ct/src/verify/sct.rs — SCT signature verification (concerns 1, 2)
- pkix-ct/src/verify/merkle.rs — Merkle inclusion + tree leaf builders (concerns 3, 4)
- pkix-ct/src/verify/sth.rs — STH verification (concern 5)
- pkix-ct/src/verify/mod.rs — re-exports + SctVerifier type
- pkix-ct/src/verify/internal.rs — shared helpers (concern 6)

Marked opinion because the file works as-is and the split is genuinely a style preference. But pre-1.0 is the cheap time to do it.
title: Module verify.rs is 1359 lines; merge inner_hash/merkle_leaf_hash/inclusion logic into a merkle submodule
